acceptance: A TPC-H and a TPC-DS run at scale factor 10 on a SQL platform and on a DataFrame platform record per-query pass or fail against the reference, for the stream that ran
Each reference file carries its provenance, and the validator output names the reference kind
The guard fails when a reference for a ranked cohort is removed
Two-engine comparison results are in the pull request, with any disagreement reported and not resolved by choice
context: Step of the corpus rule remediation plan (crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan). description:
## Problem
References exist only for TPC-H 0.01, 0.1, 1; TPC-DS 0.01, 0.1; SSB 0.01 to 10 (R). Ranked cohorts exist above those. TPC-DS parameters depend on the stream: the DataFrame validator accepts only stream 0 as reference, while measured iterations run on streams 1 and up (dataframe/query_validation.py ~194; tpcds/power_test.py ~29) (R).

## Change
- List the benchmark and scale pairs that hold a ranked cohort (from the snapshot). For TPC-H, TPC-DS and SSB at those scales, add references through the shared loader, for each stream a measured iteration can use.
- Each reference records how it was made: generator, data checksum, reference engine and version, date. Above the scales the TPC answer sets cover it is labelled "agreement with <engine>", not the specification's answer.
- Guard: a ranked cohort for these three benchmarks without a reference fails CI.

## Decision gates
- Reference engine default: DuckDB SQL on the same generated data. Where a second engine is available at that scale, compare the two; if they disagree on any query, stop and report the query; do not pick one.
- Generating references at scale factor 10 is heavy work: make heavy-run only, announce command, maximum run time and log path.
- TPC-H scale factor 10 data from the defective generator (known_defects defective-macdbgen-addresses) must not be used.

## Guardrails (apply to every item of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix. Only the pvm-p* items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file to make it pass. Outcomes change only through the rule.
- Any change to the outcome of a stored result must show in the committed outcome snapshot diff in the same pull request and be explained in its body.
- No new stored class value. No reader may decide anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- Paths, line numbers and counts in this plan were read on 2026-11-22 at develop 93f3360. Re-read before editing; report drift, do not guess.
- AGENTS.md applies: linked worktree, one pull request per item, close at the merged pull request, heavy work only through make heavy-run, no live cloud run without owner approval in that task.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded default. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner. Never substitute a different owner decision.
- Read crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan first: it holds the owner decisions, the rule table and the fault types (T1 to T5).
